results.question: Who are the best roofers in Owasso, OK?

chatgpt.text:
My **short list for an Owasso homeowner**:

1. **GoldenRite Roofing & Construction** — Best all-around pick. Strong local review volume, top-ranked in Owasso, and listed by GAF as a **Master Elite** contractor, which can matter for warranty options. ([bestprosintown.com](https://www.bestprosintown.com/ok/owasso/roofing/?utm_source=openai))  
2. **Dun-Rite Roofing** — Safest “established local” choice. Owasso-based, in business since 1991, BBB accredited/A+ rated, and GAF Certified. Good fit if you want a long track record. ([bbb.org](https://www.bbb.org/us/ok/owasso/profile/roofing-contractors/dun-rite-roofing-inc-1025-18203333?utm_source=openai))  
3. **Ridgeback Roofing & Construction** — Worth a bid for storm/insurance work; recent review profiles show very strong homeowner feedback for responsiveness and cleanup. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/ridgeback-roofing-construction-llc-165301429484325?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Fairway Roofing & Construction** — Good smaller/local option for repairs or roof-plus-remodeling needs; listed locally with solid ratings. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/fairway-roofing-construction-164721107371126?utm_source=openai))  

Before signing, verify their **current Oklahoma CIB roofing registration** and insurance; Oklahoma requires roofers to hold valid registration. ([oklahoma.gov](https://oklahoma.gov/cib/your-industry/roofing/active-roofing-contractor-requirements.html?utm_source=openai)) Get 2–3 written bids with shingle brand, ventilation, decking, warranty, and cleanup spelled out.

gemini.text:
If I were looking for a reliable roofer in Owasso, these are the top three local companies I’d put at the top of my list:

1. **Anchor Roofing & Construction:** Located right here in the area, Anchor is a highly trusted, family-owned option. They are fantastic at navigating complex insurance claims after our crazy Oklahoma hail storms, and their crews leave your yard spotless when they’re done.
2. **Pro-Tech Roofing:** Serving the Owasso and Tulsa metro area, Pro-Tech has a stellar reputation for honesty and communication. They don't use high-pressure sales tactics, provide clear, upfront estimates, and use top-tier materials.
3. **Perfection Roofing:** They’ve been serving the area for over 40 years and are a **GAF Master Elite Contractor**—a certification held by only the top 2% of roofers nationwide. This means they can offer superior factory warranties that standard contractors can't match.

**Homeowner Tip:** No matter who you choose, always verify they are actively registered with the **Oklahoma Construction Industries Board (CIB)** and carry adequate liability and workers' compensation insurance before signing anything!
